timeline.text: The narration voice was hardcoded — changing it meant shipping new code, and nobody could see what one explainer video actually cost.
Now an admin card swaps the voice per language, no deploy needed.
Every render tries one text-to-speech engine first, and quietly falls back if it fails.
Each video's cost — AI time, voice, and render minutes — gets logged instead of guessed.
One card now shows all three costs, added up, per video.
